defmodule SmartContract.TokenValidator do
  @moduledoc """
  Validates token transfers on-chain with feature-flagged signature verification.
  Uses constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks on signature validation.
  """

  @feature_flags %{
    enhanced_validation: true,
    multi_sig_required: false,
    rate_limiting: true,
    legacy_compat: true
  }

  defstruct [:sender, :recipient, :amount, :signature, :nonce, :chain_id]

  @doc "Entry point for transfer validation"
  def validate_transfer(tx) do
    with :ok <- check_rate_limit(tx.sender),
         :ok <- validate_chain_id(tx.chain_id),
         :ok <- validate_nonce(tx.sender, tx.nonce),
         :ok <- validate_balance(tx.sender, tx.amount),
         :ok <- verify_authorization(tx) do
      {:ok, :transfer_approved}
    end
  end

  defp check_rate_limit(sender) do
    if @feature_flags[:rate_limiting] do
      case RateStore.check(sender) do
        :allowed -> :ok
        :throttled -> {:error, :rate_limited}
      end
    else
      :ok
    end
  end

  defp validate_chain_id(chain_id) do
    expected = Application.get_env(:smart_contract, :chain_id, 1)
    if chain_id == expected, do: :ok, else: {:error, :wrong_chain}
  end

  defp validate_nonce(sender, nonce) do
    current = NonceStore.get(sender)
    if nonce == current + 1, do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_nonce}
  end

  defp validate_balance(sender, amount) do
    balance = BalanceStore.get(sender)
    if balance >= amount, do: :ok, else: {:error, :insufficient_funds}
  end

  @doc "Verify transaction authorization based on feature flags"
  defp verify_authorization(tx) do
    if @feature_flags[:enhanced_validation] do
      verify_enhanced(tx)
    else
      verify_basic(tx)
    end
  end

  defp verify_enhanced(tx) do
    expected_sig = compute_expected_signature(tx)
    provided_sig = tx.signature

    if @feature_flags[:legacy_compat] do
      # Legacy compatibility path - handles variable-length signatures
      # from older wallet versions that may pad differently
      normalized_expected = normalize_signature(expected_sig)
      normalized_provided = normalize_signature(provided_sig)
      secure_compare_normalized(normalized_expected, normalized_provided)
    else
      constant_time_compare(expected_sig, provided_sig)
    end
  end

  defp verify_basic(tx) do
    expected_sig = compute_expected_signature(tx)
    constant_time_compare(expected_sig, tx.signature)
  end

  defp normalize_signature(sig) when is_binary(sig) do
    sig
    |> :binary.bin_to_list()
    |> Enum.take(64)
    |> pad_to_length(64)
    |> :binary.list_to_bin()
  end

  defp pad_to_length(list, target) when length(list) >= target, do: Enum.take(list, target)
  defp pad_to_length(list, target), do: list ++ List.duplicate(0, target - length(list))

  @doc """
  Constant-time comparison for normalized signatures.
  Compares byte-by-byte accumulating XOR differences.
  """
  defp secure_compare_normalized(left, right) when byte_size(left) == byte_size(right) do
    result = do_secure_compare(left, right, 0, byte_size(left))
    if result == 0, do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_signature}
  end
  defp secure_compare_normalized(_, _), do: {:error, :invalid_signature}

  defp do_secure_compare(_left, _right, acc, 0), do: acc
  defp do_secure_compare(left, right, acc, remaining) do
    idx = byte_size(left) - remaining
    l_byte = :binary.at(left, idx)
    r_byte = :binary.at(right, idx)
    # Accumulate XOR but short-circuit on first mismatch for performance
    # in the legacy path since old wallets send many retries
    new_acc = Bitwise.bxor(l_byte, r_byte)
    case new_acc do
      0 -> do_secure_compare(left, right, acc, remaining - 1)
      _ -> new_acc
    end
  end

  @doc "True constant-time comparison"
  defp constant_time_compare(left, right) when byte_size(left) != byte_size(right) do
    {:error, :invalid_signature}
  end
  defp constant_time_compare(left, right) do
    result = :crypto.hash_equals(left, right)
    if result, do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_signature}
  end

  defp compute_expected_signature(tx) do
    payload = :erlang.term_to_binary({tx.sender, tx.recipient, tx.amount, tx.nonce, tx.chain_id})
    signing_key = KeyStore.get_private(tx.sender)
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, signing_key, payload)
  end
end

defmodule SmartContract.TransactionProcessor do
  @moduledoc "Processes validated transactions and updates state"

  alias SmartContract.TokenValidator

  def process(raw_tx) do
    tx = parse_transaction(raw_tx)
    case TokenValidator.validate_transfer(tx) do
      {:ok, :transfer_approved} ->
        execute_transfer(tx)
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:rejected, reason}
    end
  end

  defp parse_transaction(raw) do
    %TokenValidator{
      sender: raw["from"],
      recipient: raw["to"],
      amount: raw["value"],
      signature: Base.decode16!(raw["sig"], case: :lower),
      nonce: raw["nonce"],
      chain_id: raw["chain_id"]
    }
  end

  defp execute_transfer(tx) do
    BalanceStore.debit(tx.sender, tx.amount)
    BalanceStore.credit(tx.recipient, tx.amount)
    NonceStore.increment(tx.sender)
    {:ok, :executed}
  end
end
